message.content:
Sildenafil citrate tablets are a medicament in dosage form, so they fall in heading 3004. Sildenafil is a heterocyclic compound with a pyrazolopyrimidinone ring, containing nitrogen heteroatoms only. The relevant subheading is 3004.90 (other medicaments), and I recall the statistical suffix 3004.90.9239 as covering "other" medicaments, but I'm not certain of it.

From memory, the 3004.90.92 breakout is "Other: Other: Other", with suffixes such as 3004.90.9215 for ... and 3004.90.9235 and 3004.90.9239 under it. I'm unsure of the exact one. A more commonly used code for Viagra-type products is 3004.90.9250 ("Other: Other: Other: Other"), but I can't verify that.

3004.90.92 is the "Other" group under 3004.90.91 and 3004.90.92. I'll go with 3004.90.9290 as the general residual.

Under 3004.90.92, the sub-lines I recall include 3004.90.9202, 9205 (anti-infectives?), 9210, 9215, 9220, 9225, 9230, 9235, 9240, 9245, 9250, 9255, 9260, 9270, and 9290. These are statistical lines grouped by therapeutic class, and 3004.90.9290 is the generic "Other" one. Because ED and PAH are not clearly assigned to a specific class line, the residual is the safest choice.
